arxiv-1607-04356.title: A versatile rotary-stage high frequency probe station for studying magnetic films and devices
arxiv-1607-04356.creator: Shikun He, Zhaoliang Meng, Lisen Huang, Lee Koon Yap, Tiejun Zhou, Christos Panagopoulos
arxiv-1607-04356.description: Abstract We present a rotary-stage microwave probe station suitable for magnetic films and spintronic devices. Two stages, one for field rotation from parallel to perpendicular to the sample plane (Out-of-Plane) and the other intended for field rotation within the sample plane (In-Plane) have been designed.

arxiv-2201-05420.title: A Study of Transducer based End-to-End ASR with ESPnet: Architecture, Auxiliary Loss and Decoding Strategies
arxiv-2201-05420.creator: Florian Boyer, Yusuke Shinohara, Takaaki Ishii, Hirofumi Inaguma, Shinji Watanabe
arxiv-2201-05420.description: Abstract In this study, we present recent developments of models trained with the RNN-T loss in ESPnet. It involves the use of various architectures such as recently proposed Conformer, multi-task learning with different auxiliary criteria and multiple decoding strategies, including our own proposition.

arxiv-2205-09240.title: Debiasing Neural Retrieval via In-batch Balancing Regularization
arxiv-2205-09240.creator: Yuantong Li, Xiaokai Wei, Zijian Wang, Shen Wang, Parminder Bhatia, Xiaofei Ma, Andrew Arnold
arxiv-2205-09240.description: Abstract People frequently interact with information retrieval (IR) systems, however, IR models exhibit biases and discrimination towards various demographics. The in-processing fair ranking methods provide a trade-offs between accuracy and fairness through adding a fairness-related regularization term in the loss function.

arxiv-2212-14880.title: Pseudogap effects in the strongly correlated regime of the two-dimensional Fermi gas
arxiv-2212-14880.creator: S. Ramachandran 1, S. Jensen 2, Y. Alhassid 1
arxiv-2212-14880.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by S. Ramachandran 1, S. Jensen 2, Y. Alhassid 1. The two-species Fermi gas with attractive short-range interactions in two spatial dimensions provides a paradigmatic system for the understanding of strongly correlated Fermi superfluids in two dimensions. It is known to exhibit a BEC-BCS crossover as a function of ln ⁡ ( k F ​ a ) \ln(k_{F}a) , where a a is the scattering length, and to undergo a Berezinskii-Kosterlitz-Thouless superfluid transition below a critical temperature T c T_{c} .

arxiv-2303-17723.title: The cosmological constant is probably still zero
arxiv-2303-17723.creator: Yang Liu, Antonio Padilla, and Francisco G. Pedro
arxiv-2303-17723.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Yang Liu, Antonio Padilla, and Francisco G. Pedro. We consider a wide class of four-dimensional effective field theories in which gravity is coupled to multiple four-forms and their dual scalar fields, with membrane sources charged under the corresponding three-form potentials. Four-form flux, quantised in units of the membrane charges, generically generates a landscape of vacua with a range of values for the cosmological constant that is scanned through membrane nucleation.

arxiv-2307-05009.title: Enhancement of Superconductivity in the Fibonacci Chain
arxiv-2307-05009.creator: Meng Sun, Tilen Čadež, Igor Yurkevich, Alexei Andreanov
arxiv-2307-05009.description: Abstract We study the interplay between quasi-periodic disorder and superconductivity in a 1D tight-binding model with the quasi-periodic modulation of on-site energies that follow the Fibonacci rule and all the eigenstates are multifractal. As a signature of multifractality, we observe the power-law dependence of the correlation between different single-particle eigenstates as a function of their energy difference.

arxiv-2411-11459.title: Formation of compact hierarchical triples Volume: 50
arxiv-2411-11459.creator: A. Moharana \orcid 0000-0002-9616-512X, K.G. Hełminiak \orcid 0000-0002-7650-3603, T. Pawar, G. Pawar \orcid 0000-0003-3639-9052
arxiv-2411-11459.description: Abstract Compact hierarchical triples (CHTs) are triple stars where the tertiary is in an orbit of period less than 1000 d. They were thought to be rare but we are discovering more of these systems recently, thanks to space-based missions like TESS, Kepler, and GAIA.

arxiv-2505-12100.title: Improving Fairness in LLMs Through Testing-Time Adversaries
arxiv-2505-12100.creator: Isabela Pereira Gregio, Ian Pons, Anna Helena Reali Costa, Artur Jordão
arxiv-2505-12100.description: Abstract Large Language Models (LLMs) push the bound-aries in natural language processing and generative AI, driving progress across various aspects of modern society. Unfortunately, the pervasive issue of bias in LLMs responses (i.e., predictions) poses a significant and open challenge, hindering their application in tasks involving ethical sensitivity and responsible decision-making.

arxiv-2505-17785.title: Heterogeneous Transmission of Analog Radio and Digital Coherent Signals Over Multi-Span Metro and PON for Bandwidth-Efficient Fronthaul in mmWave Centralized RAN Networks [Invited] Journal: jocn DOI: http://doi.org/10.1364/JOCN.551296
arxiv-2505-17785.creator: Devika Dass, Dan Kilper, Liam Barry, Marco Ruffini
arxiv-2505-17785.description: Abstract We experimentally investigate the transparent coexistence of heterogeneous Analog Radio-over-Fiber (ARoF) and Digital Coherent Optical (DCO) signals in a converged metro/PON network. Our streamlined setup employs RF generation via optical heterodyning, so that both carrier and modulated signals can be generated centrally and transmitted to the antenna site, across a metro network and Passive Optical Network (PON).

arxiv-2509-00697.title: Multi-Scale Analysis of Nifty 50: Return Characteristics, Valuation Dynamics and Market Complexity (1990–2024)
arxiv-2509-00697.creator: Chandradew Sharma
arxiv-2509-00697.description: Abstract This study presents a unified, distribution-aware, and complexity-informed framework for understanding equity return dynamics in the Indian market, using 34 years (1990–2024) of Nifty 50 index data. Addressing a key gap in the literature, we demonstrate that the price-to-earnings (P/E) ratio, as a valuation metric, may probabilistically map return distributions across investment horizons spanning from days to decades.

pmc-10574675.title: Cancer Metabolism as a Therapeutic Target and Review of Interventions
pmc-10574675.creator: Matthew T. J. Halma, Jack A. Tuszynski, Paul E. Marik
pmc-10574675.description: Cancer is amenable to low-cost treatments, given that it has a significant metabolic component, which can be affected through diet and lifestyle change at minimal cost. The Warburg hypothesis states that cancer cells have an altered cell metabolism towards anaerobic glycolysis. Given this metabolic reprogramming in cancer cells, it is possible to target cancers metabolically by depriving them of glucose.

pmc-10638397.title: Engineering sulfonate group donor regeneration systems to boost biosynthesis of sulfated compounds
pmc-10638397.creator: Ruirui Xu, Weijao Zhang, Xintong Xi, Jiamin Chen, Yang Wang, Guocheng Du, Jianghua Li, Jian Chen, Zhen Kang
pmc-10638397.description: Sulfonation as one of the most important modification reactions in nature is essential for many biological macromolecules to function. Development of green sulfonate group donor regeneration systems to efficiently sulfonate compounds of interest is always attractive. Here, we design and engineer two different sulfonate group donor regeneration systems to boost the biosynthesis of sulfated compounds.

pmc-10691293.title: Length Changes of the Medial Patellofemoral Ligament During In Vivo Knee Motion: An Evaluation Using Dynamic Computed Tomography
pmc-10691293.creator: Miriam R Boot, Sebastiaan AW van de Groes, Hans Dunning, Esther Tanck, Dennis Janssen
pmc-10691293.description: Background:Medial patellofemoral ligament (MPFL) reconstruction is associated with high complication rates because of graft overloading from incorrect graft positioning. To improve clinical outcomes, it is crucial to gain a better understanding of MPFL elongation patterns.Purpose:To assess MPFL length changes in healthy knees from 0° to 90° of dynamic flexion and their relationship with anatomic parameters of the patellofemoral joint.

pmc-11511125.title: A Distributed VMD-BiLSTM Model for Taxi Demand Forecasting with GPS Sensor Data
pmc-11511125.creator: Hasan A H Naji, Qingji Xue, Tianfeng Li, Paolo Bellavista
pmc-11511125.description: With the ubiquitous deployment of mobile and sensor technologies in modes of transportation, taxis have become a significant component of public transportation. pmc-11606832.title: Microalgae as a potential raw material for plant‐based seafood alternatives: A comprehensive review
pmc-11606832.creator: Shahida Anusha Siddiqui, İlknur Ucak, Maliha Afreen, Abhilash Sasidharan, Bello Mohammed Yunusa, Shuva Bhowmik, Ravi Pandiselvam, Tigran Garrievich Ambartsumov, Mohd Asif Shah

pmc-12409410.title: The aflatoxin B1-induced formamidopyrimidine adduct is repaired by transcription-coupled nucleotide excision repair in human cells
pmc-12409410.creator: Daniel J Laverty, Rachana Tomar, Sophie Erlich, Michael P Stone, Zachary D Nagel
pmc-12409410.description: The mycotoxin, aflatoxin B1 (AFB1), is a potent mutagen that contaminates agricultural food supplies. After ingestion, AFB1 is oxidized into a reactive electrophile that alkylates DNA, forming bulky lesions such as the genotoxic formamidopyrimidine lesion, AFB1-Fapy dG. This lesion is mainly repaired by nucleotide excision repair (NER) in bacteria; however, in humans the picture is less clear.

pmc-12751087.title: Central leptin pathways in metabolic homeostasis
pmc-12751087.creator: Yuying Zhao, Connor Laule, Kamal Rahmouni
pmc-12751087.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). Obesity continues to be a major global health crisis, contributing to the rising prevalence of metabolic disorders such as type 2 diabetes, cardiovascular disease, and certain cancers. Central to the regulation of energy homeostasis is the adipocyte-derived hormone leptin, which serves as a key afferent signal to the central nervous system to suppress food intake, enhance energy expenditure, and maintain glucose balance.

pmc-12985804.creator: Lamis El Harake, Mohamed Al-Kazaz, Paul C Cremer, Douglas R Johnston

Clinical studies suggest a combination of procarbazine, lomustine (CCNU) and vincristine (PCV) provides superior survival and progression delay, but toxicities limit use. Given the ongoing debate over the role of vincristine in glioma chemotherapy amid the dominance of TMZ, simplified procarbazine and CCNU (PC) regimens warrant renewed evaluation.

This article described an ultra-high performance liquid chromatography-tandem mass spectrometry (UPLC-MS/MS) method for the quantitative analysis of entinostat in human plasma.

pmc-13374766.title: Phytotherapeutics self-microemulsifying systems in pellet dosage form for enhanced intestinal drug delivery: formulation, stability, and in-vivo performance
pmc-13374766.creator: Gabriela Koutná, Jan Kotouček, Jan Macků, Kateřina Kubová, Martina Urbanová, Larisa Janisová, Ivana Šeděnková, Jan Muselík, Jakub Vysloužil, Josef Mašek, Eliška Mašková, Miroslava Pavelková, David Vetchý, Jiří Brus

pmc-13500730.title: 药代动力学特性下的癫痫患儿左乙拉西坦血药浓度预测模型构建：多元线性回归与复杂算法比较
pmc-13500730.creator: 奕伟 谢, 委 吴, 跃文 陈, 周杰 刘
pmc-13500730.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). 目的左乙拉西坦(levetiracetam，LEV)主要经肾以原形清除，其稳态血药浓度与剂量、体重、肾功能及合并用药等因素相关，但癫痫患儿受生长发育和个体药代动力学差异影响，浓度变异较明显。本研究比较多元线性回归与复杂机器学习算法预测癫痫患儿LEV稳态谷浓度的性能差异，评估增加模型复杂度对预测准确性和稳定性的影响。方法回顾性收集福建省福州儿童医院(福州市第一总医院儿童专科院区)2023年6月1日至2024年10月30日接受LEV治疗并完成治疗药物监测(therapeutic drug monitoring，TDM)的癫痫患儿资料。纳入年龄1~18岁、LEV血药浓度达到稳态且临床资料完整的696例患儿，按8꞉2比例随机分为训练集556例和测试集140例。候选协变量包括年龄、性别、体重、每日总剂量、剂型、合用抗癫痫药物及肝肾功能、血液学指标等实验室指标。采用方差膨胀因子分析共线性，采用Pearson相关分析评价协变量与LEV稳态谷浓度的关系。分别利用Lasso回归和随机森林进行特征筛选，并构建普通线性回归、岭回归、Lasso回归、贝叶斯线性回归、支持向量回归、随机森林回归和XGBoost回归模型。所有模型均在训练集上完成训练、10折交叉验证和超参数调优，并在测试集上以决定系数R 2、平均绝对误差(mean absolute error，MAE)和均方根误差(root mean square error，RMSE)评价预测性能。结果相关性分析显示，每日按体重剂量与LEV浓度呈中等正相关(r=0.399，P<0.001)，为最主要的线性相关变量；每日总剂量次之(r=0.287，P<0.001)。氯巴占剂量、丙戊酸浓度、卡马西平剂量、性别和白蛋白等变量也与LEV浓度存在不同程度相关性。Lasso回归和随机森林特征重要性分析均提示，每日按体重剂量是贡献最高的预测变量，肾功能相关指标、白蛋白、血钾、每日总剂量及部分合用抗癫痫药物对LEV浓度变异也有一定影响。基于Lasso特征选择结果，普通线性回归在独立测试集中表现较稳定，R 2为0.473，RMSE为3.618 mg/L，MAE为2.793 mg/L；Lasso回归、岭回归和贝叶斯线性回归性能相近，R 2分别为0.472、0.465和0.464。非线性模型中，支持向量回归R 2为0.458，接近线性模型；随机森林回归和XGBoost回归R 2分别为0.402和0.378，未显示更优的预测性能。年龄分层分析显示，线性回归在各年龄段中整体表现稳定；3~5岁组各模型预测性能均下降，提示该年龄段的LEV浓度变异可能难以由现有常规协变量充分解释。拟合情况和误差分析显示，各模型预测值总体沿y=x参考线分布，相对预测误差(relative prediction error，PE%)中位数接近0。较大相对误差主要集中于<10 mg/L的低浓度区间；在10~<20 mg/L和20~<30 mg/L等临床主要关注范围内，多数样本|PE%|≤30%。仅在浓度极高或极低的个体中观察到轻微回归均值效应，表现为低浓度略高估、高浓度略低估。线性回归残差总体围绕0分布，未见明显异方差性或高影响样本主导模型结果。结论在纳入剂量、体重、肾功能、合并用药及常规实验室指标后，癫痫患儿LEV稳态谷浓度的主要可预测信息可由多元线性回归模型所刻画，其整体预测性能、误差稳定性和临床解释性方面不低于复杂机器学习模型。每日按体重剂量是影响LEV稳态谷浓度的核心变量，肾功能、白蛋白、血钾及部分合用抗癫痫药物可进一步解释个体浓度差异。模型仍存在未解释的个体间变异，可能与用药依从性、发育成熟度等因素有关。模型结果可作为TDM解释和剂量调整的辅助信息，实际应用需结合患儿临床表现和治疗反应综合判断。 左乙拉西坦(levetiracetam，LEV)是一种广谱抗癫痫药，广泛应用于儿童及成人癫痫的治疗[1]。LEV药代动力学特征较为理想：口服后吸收迅速且完全，生物利用度超过95%，在体内不经肝酶代谢，主要以原形经肾清除[2]。研究[3]表明，LEV的药代动力学呈线性，即剂量与暴露浓度之间近似成正比。因此，在临床实践中通常根据每日按体重剂量即可粗略估算LEV稳态血药浓度，不需要频繁开展治疗药物监测(therapeutic drug monitoring，TDM)。然而，在某些特殊人群(如儿童、老年人、肾功能不全或重症患者)中，LEV的药代动力学参数出现显著个体差异，需依赖TDM的结果调整剂量以实现个体化治疗[3-4]。 目前LEV的药代动力学研究多采用群体药代动力学(population pharmacokinetics，PopPK)方法，应用非线性混合效应模型(nonlinear mixed effects modeling，NLME)来刻画药物浓度-时间变化及个体间变异因素。近年来，已有针对中国癫痫患儿的LEV PopPK研究[5](采用一室模型)，并证实体重和肾功能[如肌酐(creatinine，Cr)清除率]是影响LEV清除的关键协变量。尽管纳入这些协变量可在群体层面显著减少模型残差，但基于体重和肾功能等协变量建立的结构模型在个体层面的预测能力仍然有限。若能够结合患者既往TDM数据并进行个体化贝叶斯估计，则可显著提升个体预测准确度[6]。这提示在缺乏既往LEV的TDM数据时，仅依赖协变量构建的群体结构模型难以充分捕捉个体浓度的变异性。 近年来，随着人工智能技术的发展，各种机器学习方法已逐步引入TDM数据分析与个体化用药预测中[7]。相较于传统线性回归，非线性机器学习模型(如支持向量回归、随机森林、梯度提升树、人工神经网络)能够捕捉复杂的非线性关系和特征间高阶交互作用，因而被认为具有更强的拟合能力[7]。部分研究已尝试将神经网络模型应用于癫痫患儿LEV稳态血药浓度预测，并在特定人群中取得一定的效果。如，赵婷等[8]基于新疆维吾尔族癫痫患儿330例LEV样本建立神经网络模型，在50例独立数据上验证，平均预测误差(mean prediction error，MPE)为(-2.15±6.97)%，提示该模型在特定人群中有潜在的应用价值。然而，机器学习模型的实际表现受限于样本量、特征选择和泛化能力，尤其在数据规模较小或变量噪声较大的情况下，复杂模型可能过拟合，未必优于结构简单、解释性强的线性模型。 LEV作为一种典型的线性药代动力学药物，其稳态血药浓度理论上应与剂量、体重等因素呈稳定的线性关系。然而，在临床中，儿童的生理发育不平衡、合用药物干扰、疾病状态变化等均可能削弱这种线性关联，使得浓度预测面临不确定性。在此背景下，引入更复杂的非线性机器学习模型能否在真实世界LEV TDM数据中显著提升预测性能，仍缺乏系统性的实证比较。因此，本研究基于单中心儿童癫痫患者的真实世界LEV TDM数据，在临床可获得常规协变量的约束条件下，系统比较线性回归模型与多种非线性机器学习模型在LEV稳态血药浓度预测中的表现。通过多层次评估模型的整体性能、个体预测误差及稳定性特征，探讨在癫痫患儿LEV这一药代动力学结构相对明确的应用场景中，模型复杂度与预测收益之间的关系，为临床个体化给药建模策略的选择提供方法学层面的参考。 对象与方法 伦理声明 本研究已获得福建省福州儿童医院(福州市第一总医院儿童专科院区)伦理委员会的批准(2025伦审〔研〕第28号)。 对象 回顾性收集福建省福州儿童医院癫痫患儿于2023年6月1日至2024年10月30日接受LEV治疗的TDM数据及相关临床信息。纳入标准：1)年龄1~18岁，符合国际抗癫痫联盟癫痫诊断标准[9]；2)接受LEV治疗，血药浓度已达稳态；3)临床资料完整，包含人口学特征、实验室指标、合用药物信息及TDM结果。排除标准：临床资料缺失或信息不完整，无法支持建模分析的病例。 经初筛后，共纳入696例患儿的临床数据。采用随机抽样法将数据按8:2比例划分为训练集(556例)与测试集(140例)。纳入协变量：人口学信息，包括年龄、性别、体重；LEV用药信息，包括每日总剂量、每日按体重剂量、剂型；合用药物，包括奥卡西平、丙戊酸、拉莫三嗪、卡马西平、氯巴占、托吡酯、拉考沙胺；实验室指标，包括谷丙转氨酶(alanine aminotransferase，ALT)、天冬氨酸氨基转移酶(aspartate transferase，AST)、总胆红素(total bilirubin，TB)、直接胆红素(direct bilirubin，DB)、Cr、尿素、白蛋白(albumin，ALB)、血钾(potassium，K+)、血红蛋白(hemoglobin，HGB)、红细胞比容(hematocrit，HCT)、平均红细胞血红蛋白含量(mean corpuscular hemoglobin，MCH)、平均血红蛋白浓度(mean corpuscular hemoglobin concentration，MCHC)。 目标变量为LEV稳态谷浓度。 方法 数据预处理 采用Filler公式，根据Cr水平计算估算肾小球滤过率(estimated glomerular filtration rate，eGFR)，以反映患儿肾功能。对分类变量进行数值化编码，其中性别为0=女、1=男，给药剂型为0=口服溶液、1=片剂。 在特征筛选前，进行协变量共线性与相关性分析。首先，采用方差膨胀因子(variance inflation factor，VIF)评估多重共线性。一般认为，VIF>10视为严重共线性予以剔除，5<VIF≤10提示中等程度共线性，结合临床意义和建模需要酌情保留。其次，采用Pearson相关性系数评估各候选协变量与目标变量间的线性相关性，以辅助特征筛选与模型解释。 特征选择 为优化模型性能并增强临床解释性，采用套索(Lasso)回归和随机森林模型2种策略进行特征选择。其中，Lasso回归通过10折交叉验证确定正则化系数α的最优值，对线性回归系数进行稀疏化，从而筛选出对目标变量影响显著的变量。鉴于线性模型在处理非线性关系方面的局限性，引入基于决策树的随机森林模型评估特征的重要性，识别各候选协变量在预测LEV血药浓度中的贡献。 模型建立 为全面评估不同建模策略在预测LEV稳态谷浓度中的表现，研究比较了多种线性与非线性回归模型的性能。采用的线性建模方法包括普通最小二乘回归、岭回归、Lasso回归及贝叶斯(Bayesian)线性回归；非线性模型则包括随机森林回归(random forest regression，RFR)、XGBoost回归及支持向量回归(support vector regression，SVR)。 所有模型均使用相同的特征集，以确保比较的公平性和一致性。针对需要依赖距离或内积计算的模型(如线性回归类与SVR)，在模型训练前对连续型输入变量进行了标准化处理，采用Z-score方法(即均值为0，标准差为1)，以消除不同变量之间的量纲差异对模型训练带来的影响。基于树结构的模型(包括RFR和XGBoost)，因其不受变量尺度影响，故直接使用原始数值进行训练。 在超参数调优方面，采用2阶段策略：首先进行广泛的随机搜索，快速探索超参数空间，筛选出潜在优值区间。随后对初筛结果进一步应用网格搜索，精细调整关键参数，以获得性能最优模型。所有模型的训练与调优均在训练集上完成，并在独立测试集上进行泛化性能评估。 性能评估 所有模型的训练、交叉验证(10折)及超参数调优均在训练集上完成，最终模型的泛化性能评估在独立测试集上完成。通过计算测试集上的决定系数R 2、平均绝对误差(mean absolute error，MAE)和均方根误差(root mean square error，RMSE)，系统比较不同模型在真实数据下的泛化性能差异。该策略可更准确地反映模型在新样本中的预测能力，避免因交叉验证结果过于理想化而高估模型效果。 统计学处理 采用Python语言和Scikit-learn库等相关程序包完成模型训练和分析。正态或近似正态分布的连续变量以均数±标准差表示，组间比较采用t检验；非正态分布的连续变量以中位数(第1四分位数，第3四分位数)表示，组间比较采用Mann-Whitney U检验。P<0.05为差异有统计学意义。 结
